name: Trastuzumab + CISplatin + Capecitabine (or Fluorouracil), HER2-positive (ToGA)

biomarkers.note: HER2-directed therapy requires HER2-positive (HER2-overexpressing) disease by IHC 3+ or ISH or FISH amplification. In ToGA, 22.1% of screened gastric or GEJ adenocarcinomas tested HER2-positive. HER2 status gates this regimen. Per DeVita 12th ed. (ToGA) and Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Gastric Cancer v3.2026.

lineOfTherapy: first-line systemic therapy for HER2-positive metastatic or unresectable gastric or GEJ adenocarcinoma

eligibilityCriteria.locator: lines 98862 to 98871 (ToGA: HER2 overexpression by FISH and IHC required)

drugs.name: Trastuzumab (loading dose)

provenance.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
provenance.locator: line 98871 states the 6 mg/kg every-3-week trastuzumab dose only; a loading dose is NOT stated in the cited source

drugs.notes: VERIFY: DeVita 12th ed. (line 98871) states trastuzumab 6 mg/kg once every 3 weeks (maintenance) and does not print a loading dose. The conventional first-cycle trastuzumab loading dose is 8 mg/kg but is not established by the cited source; dosePerUnit left as VERIFY for clinical review. Cardiac (LVEF) monitoring required.

drugs.name: Trastuzumab (maintenance)

provenance.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.

drugs.notes: Source: DeVita 12th ed., line 98871. Trastuzumab 6 mg/kg IV on day 1, every 3 weeks (maintenance). Cardiac (LVEF) monitoring required; continued with and beyond chemotherapy.

drugs.name: CISplatin

provenance.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
provenance.locator: line 98870 (cisplatin 80 mg/m2 on day 1, cycled every 3 weeks)

drugs.notes: Source: DeVita 12th ed., line 98870. CISplatin 80 mg/m2 IV on day 1, every 3 weeks. Tall-man per ISMP. Requires pre- and post-hydration; monitor for nephrotoxicity, ototoxicity, and neurotoxicity.

drugs.name: Capecitabine

provenance.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
provenance.locator: line 98868 (capecitabine 1000 mg/m2 twice a day for 14 days)

drugs.notes: Source: DeVita 12th ed., line 98868. Capecitabine 1000 mg/m2 orally twice daily on days 1 to 14 (this per-dose is the twice-daily dose). Source-stated alternative to capecitabine: infusional fluorouracil 800 mg/m2 per day for 5 days (line 98869). Most ToGA patients received capecitabine plus cisplatin. DPYD deficiency raises fluoropyrimidine toxicity risk; consider DPYD testing before first dose.

premedications.name: CISplatin hydration
premedications.notes: pre- and post-hydration with magnesium and potassium replacement per cisplatin order set; antiemetic prophylaxis (high emetic risk).

supportiveCare: DPYD: consider DPYD genotype or phenotype testing before capecitabine or fluorouracil; reduce or avoid on deficiency.
CISplatin: mandatory hydration; monitor renal function, electrolytes (Mg, K), hearing, and neuropathy.
Cardiac: evaluate LVEF at baseline and periodically during trastuzumab.

Cycle count VERIFY: DeVita states cisplatin plus fluoropyrimidine cycled every 3 weeks with trastuzumab 6 mg/kg every 3 weeks; the number of chemotherapy cycles and the trastuzumab continuation duration (typically chemotherapy for a fixed number of cycles then trastuzumab until progression) are not stated in the cited source.

monitoring: LVEF at baseline and periodically during trastuzumab
renal function and electrolytes (Mg, K) before and after each CISplatin dose
audiometry / hearing assessment and neuropathy assessment (CISplatin)

doseModificationRules.condition: significant decline in LVEF or symptomatic heart failure
doseModificationRules.text: Hold trastuzumab and obtain cardiology and oncology review per LVEF guidance. Physician decides on continuation.
Hold or reduce CISplatin, or consider a less nephrotoxic platinum, per renal function. Physician decides.

core.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
core.locator: lines 98862 to 98872 (ToGA trial: capecitabine 1000 mg/m2 twice daily x14 days or infusional 5-FU 800 mg/m2/day x5 days, with cisplatin 80 mg/m2 day 1 every 3 weeks, plus trastuzumab 6 mg/kg every 3 weeks; HER2 overexpression required)

guideline.locator: Systemic Therapy, HER2-positive advanced disease, fluoropyrimidine plus platinum plus trastuzumab (guidelines/gastric.txt lines 2007 to 2016); HER2 testing under Principles of Biomarker Testing

provenanceNote: ONCQIS Standard Protocol draft for the ToGA regimen (trastuzumab plus a fluoropyrimidine plus cisplatin) in HER2-positive metastatic gastric and GEJ adenocarcinoma. Doses grounded to DeVita 12th ed. lines 98868 to 98871: capecitabine 1000 mg/m2 orally twice daily on days 1 to 14 (or infusional fluorouracil 800 mg/m2 per day for 5 days), cisplatin 80 mg/m2 on day 1 every 3 weeks, and trastuzumab 6 mg/kg every 3 weeks (maintenance). The cited source states only the 6 mg/kg maintenance trastuzumab dose and does not print a loading dose, so the trastuzumab loading dosePerUnit is left as VERIFY (conventionally 8 mg/kg but not source-established). The number of cycles and trastuzumab continuation duration are not stated in the cited source, so regimen.cycles is VERIFY. HER2-positive status gates the regimen. ISMP tall-man applied (CISplatin). Cisplatin hydration and nephro/oto/neurotoxicity monitoring, DPYD screening for the fluoropyrimidine, and LVEF monitoring for trastuzumab are flagged. Two fields remain VERIFY (trastuzumab loading dose, cycle count). This remains a StewardMD Standard Protocol; no endorsement implied.
